name: Hollis
seed: Madger’s father, alive and living in Reedbank. Measures twice; admires his son but distrusts promises made faster than plans.
design: Male badger, grizzled cheeks, navy work vest, patched tan trousers, folding boat rule.
history: A Reedbank boat fitter who built a cooperative after an employer withheld repair pay. Remained after the flood to keep local boats working.
desire: To finish a small pleasure boat with no commercial deadline.
contradiction: Uses practical criticism when the more difficult truth is that he misses his son.
relationships: Dara understands his evasions; Madger hears disapproval; Gorilla enjoys quiet work beside him.
arc: Tells Madger what he is proud of without appending a warning, then asks for company instead of inventing a repair.
story_engine: A fishing trip turns into a stubborn contest; a supposedly useless offcut solves a household problem.
writer_truth: His first boat was badly balanced. He keeps its crooked miniature on a high shelf.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
